note: views_filters_summary_eb is a thin integration submodule of views_filters_summary. It has NO config, routes, permissions, or plugins; it only implements the alter hook(s) hook_views_filters_summary_exposed_form_id_alter (primary: views_filters_summary_exposed_form_id_alter) to let the parent's Views summary area render Entity Browser's filters. Companion module: entity_browser. Grounding: easy = code facts about the hook/behaviour; medium = live module-registry introspection (declared dependencies and the implemented hook, discoverable via the extension list / module source without the companion being active); hard = building/altering the parent views_filters_summary area on a real view (vfs_task / vfs_reset), verified against live view config — since the submodule's own effect only manifests when its companion module plus a matching exposed filter render inside that area.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal submodule views_filters_summary_eb do, and which companion module (if any) does it integrate the Views Filters Summary with?
evals.expected_output: Makes the summary's remove/reset links target the correct DOM form when a view's exposed filters are embedded inside an Entity Browser. Dependencies: views_filters_summary, entity_browser.

evals.prompt: Which views_filters_summary alter hook (or core hook) does the views_filters_summary_eb submodule implement to do its job, and what does that implementation do?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_views_filters_summary_exposed_form_id_alter. This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_exposed_form_id_alter()`. In an Entity Browser display the view's exposed filters live inside the browser's own `<form id="entity-browser-...">` rather than a standalone `views-exposed-form-...`, so it rewrites the exposed form id prefix to `entity-browser-` so the summary's client-side remove/reset links find the form. Requires the Entity Browser module.

evals.prompt: In the views_filters_summary_eb submodule, describe the specific mapping or transformation it applies for its supported filter type in the Views Filters Summary.

Requires the Entity Browser module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the module registry / extension info for views_filters_summary_eb and report the module(s) it declares as dependencies in its info file.
evals.expected_output: views_filters_summary_eb declares these dependencies: views_filters_summary, entity_browser (readable via the extension list, e.g. \Drupal::service('extension.list.module')->getAllAvailableInfo()['views_filters_summary_eb']['dependencies'], or the module's .info.yml).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the views_filters_summary_eb submodule and report which views_filters_summary (or core) alter hook it implements.

The views_filters_summary_eb submodule enhances the parent views_filters_summary area. On this site there is a view 'vfs_task' with an exposed Title filter but no filters summary. Add the 'Views exposed filters summary' area handler (plugin id views_filters_summary) to a display of that view and save it.
evals.expected_output: Add a handler with plugin_id 'views_filters_summary' under display_options.footer (or header/empty) of the vfs_task view and save it.

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'vfs_reset' shows a filters summary (the kind views_filters_summary_eb enhances) but has no reset-all link. Turn on the reset-all link for that summary and save the change.
evals.expected_output: Set the views_filters_summary area's show_reset_link option to TRUE on the vfs_reset view and save.
